data.title: PowerCompute Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for August 14, 2026
data.description: PowerCompute, Inc. (NASDAQ: PWCM), based in Tampa, Florida, has disclosed that it will be holding its Q2 2026 earnings conference call and webcast on Friday, August 14, 2026 at 8:30 AM EDT. The company, which operates as a Bitcoin treasury and mining entity while also venturing into high-performance computing ("HPC") and artificial intelligence ("AI") infrastructure, shared this information today. The scheduled event is vital for stakeholders and those interested in the financial aspects of PowerCompute, Inc.

data.title: Quoin Pharmaceuticals to Announce Corporate Update and Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Friday, August 14, 2026
data.description: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd., a specialty pharmaceutical company specializing in rare and orphan diseases, will be releasing its financial results for the second quarter of 2026 on August 14, 2026. The company, trading under NASDAQ: QNRX, will provide a corporate update along with the financial report before the market opens. The update will cover the period ended on June 30, 2026. Located in ASHBURN, Va., Quoin Pharmaceuticals is currently in the late clinical-stage and aims to focus on developing treatments for rare and orphan diseases.

data.title: Micware Co., Ltd. Announces New Equity Research Report from Alphaterra Advisory
data.description: Kobe, Japan - August 7, 2026 - Micware Co., Ltd. (Nasdaq: MWC), a Japan-headquartered company specializing in software development for automotive and mobility industries, has unveiled a new research report commissioned by the company. The report, conducted by Alphaterra Advisory, a strategic consulting firm, centers on Micware's American Depositary Shares (ADSs). Each ADS symbolizes one ordinary share of the company. Micware is renowned for providing innovative IT solutions and software services, particularly tailored for automotive and mobility sectors.

data.title: SEALSQ's SEALQuantum Sovereign Quantum Vertical Stack Interconnects Its Growing Ecosystem as $200 Million SEALQuantum.com Initiative Enters Second Phase of Deployment in September
data.description: Three leading technology companies, GlobalFoundries, Quobly, and EeroQ, are coming together under a unified trust framework called Root-to-Qubit-to-Space. This collaboration involves GlobalFoundries' secure CMOS manufacturing platform, Quobly's silicon spin-qubit processors, and EeroQ's electrons-on-helium architecture. This strategic convergence aims to advance quantum computing capabilities. SEALQUANTUM.com is set to invest $100 million in new sovereign quantum assets as part of this initiative.

data.title: After More Than a Decade of Empowering Women and Girls, I Choose To Win Announces Planned Dissolution
data.description: Fort Washington, Pennsylvania - On August 7th, 2026, a Philadelphia-based nonprofit organization called I Choose To Win (ICTW) revealed its decision to disband after operating for 11 years. Throughout its tenure, ICTW has supported over 10,000 women and girls by providing education, empowerment, and essential skills for success. The organization's dissolution is set to take effect on September 30th, 2026.
